content.short: Rubic is a cross-chain tech aggregator for users and dapps.
content.description: Rubic delivers cross-chain capabilities for users and projects by aggregating blockchains, Web3 bridges, and decentralized exchanges. As a cross-chain solution aggregator for tokens and NFT bridges, signals, oracles, and smart contract executors, Rubic enables seamless interactions on your site. By integrating Rubic, users can swap tokens and NFTs across 15,500 assets, including fiat options in 250+ currencies, on both EVM and non-EVM chains without leaving your website. Your project can communicate with networks across different blockchains.
